vacancy_label: Synthetic vacancy; not a real opening

requirements.en: Enter supplied artist, track and contributor metadata accurately.
requirements.zh: 准确录入所提供的艺人、曲目及贡献者元数据。

requirements.en: Cross-check audio filenames and track order against approved release sheets.
requirements.zh: 依据获批发行表交叉核对音频文件名及曲目顺序。

requirements.en: Coordinate clarification of missing fields through the distributor’s coordinator and retain correction history.
requirements.zh: 通过发行商协调员协调澄清缺失字段，并保留更正历史。

requirements.en: Handle supplied English and Chinese title text without altering approved wording.
requirements.zh: 处理所提供的英文及中文名称文字，不改动获批措辞。

requirements.en: Preferred: experience reconciling royalty statements to distributor payments.
requirements.zh: 优先：将版税报表与发行商付款进行核对的经验。
